findings.watermark: IT小村 / LeetCode 70 remains clearly visible at top-left, separate from title and diagram in every aspect ratio.
findings.problemAndQuestion: 爬楼梯 and 为什么只记前两个数？ are readable without clipped characters or title overlap.
findings.literalStairs: The rising side-view staircase, three horizontal treads, risers, terminal flag and walker visibly replace a plain sequence of number boxes.
findings.stageAndCounts: The excerpt is explicitly labelled 第4–6阶; physical stairs 4/5/6 carry 5种/8种/13种. The numeral 13 is a method count, not a claim that the picture contains thirteen stairs.
findings.lastStepRoutes: The gold arc joins physical stair4 to stair6 (last two stairs); the teal arc joins stair5 to stair6 (last one stair). The two arcs end at the same terminal tread beneath the walker; the two-step arc clears stair5 without claiming an intermediate landing.
findings.formula: 5 + 8 = 13 matches the two predecessor method counts 5 and 8 and terminal count13.
findings.rasterFormatsConsistent: PNG and JPEG versions of each size show the same title, step/count mapping, paths, walker, terminal and watermark; JPEG compression caused no observed content loss.

fourByThreeSafeArea.composition: 1080x1440 Portrait translated to x315 and scaled0.75; relevant content is inset within that canvas.

limits: Visual review and declared source geometry support this cover check; the cover renderer does not run a separate automated DOM COPYFIT checker. No such machine pass is claimed.
The supporting pixel threshold does not replace visual reading and cannot detect arbitrary semantic mistakes or every low-contrast glyph edge.
This does not inspect the future muxed movie, full animation, voice listening, ASR, algorithm execution or website playback.
The current video.mp4 was deliberately not treated as the new movie while formal encoding was still running.
